_comment: SatisfactoryCord Pelican egg. Runs a completely vanilla Satisfactory Dedicated Server through the SatisfactoryCord Node.js wrapper.
name: SatisfactoryCord
author: SatisfactoryCord
description: SatisfactoryCord launches and supervises a vanilla Satisfactory Dedicated Server, then bridges supported server events and chat with Discord. No SML, FRM, mods, client changes, DLL injection, or modified game files.
startup: if [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" = "1" ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) $( [[ -z ${VALIDATE} ]] || printf %s "validate" ) +quit; fi; if [ ! -x /home/container/satisfactorycord-node/bin/node ]; then echo "Missing bundled Node runtime. Reinstall the server or run the install script."; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f /home/container/satisfactorycord/dist/src/index.js ]; then echo "Missing SatisfactoryCord app files in /home/container/satisfactorycord."; echo "Upload satisfactorycord.zip contents there, or set SATISFACTORYCORD_ARCHIVE_URL and reinstall."; exit 1; fi; cd /home/container/satisfactorycord && /home/container/satisfactorycord-node/bin/node dist/src/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server

echo "Installing Satisfactory Dedicated Server for SatisfactoryCord..."
apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl tar xz-utils unzip

cd /tmp
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID:-} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit

mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk{32,64}
cp -vf linux32/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
cp -vf linux64/steamclient.so /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

if [ -d /mnt/server/Engine/Binaries/Linux ]; then
  chmod +x /mnt/server/Engine/Binaries/Linux/*-Linux-Shipping || true
fi

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/FactoryServer.sh ]; then
  cat > /mnt/server/FactoryServer.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
exec ./Engine/Binaries/Linux/*-Linux-Shipping FactoryGame "$@"
EOF
fi
chmod +x /mnt/server/FactoryServer.sh

NODE_VERSION="${NODE_VERSION:-v22.13.1}"
NODE_ARCH="linux-x64"
if [ "$(uname -m)" = "aarch64" ] || [ "$(uname -m)" = "arm64" ]; then NODE_ARCH="linux-arm64"; fi
NODE_DIR=/mnt/server/satisfactorycord-node
rm -rf "$NODE_DIR"
mkdir -p "$NODE_DIR"
cd /tmp
curl -sSL -o node.tar.xz "https://nodejs.org/dist/${NODE_VERSION}/node-${NODE_VERSION}-${NODE_ARCH}.tar.xz"
tar -xJf node.tar.xz --strip-components=1 -C "$NODE_DIR"

if [ -n "${SATISFACTORYCORD_ARCHIVE_URL:-}" ]; then
  echo "Downloading SatisfactoryCord from ${SATISFACTORYCORD_ARCHIVE_URL}..."
  rm -rf /mnt/server/satisfactorycord /tmp/satisfactorycord-unpack
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/satisfactorycord /tmp/satisfactorycord-unpack
  curl -sSL -o /tmp/satisfactorycord.zip "${SATISFACTORYCORD_ARCHIVE_URL}"
  unzip -q /tmp/satisfactorycord.zip -d /tmp/satisfactorycord-unpack
  if [ -f /tmp/satisfactorycord-unpack/package.json ]; then
    cp -R /tmp/satisfactorycord-unpack/. /mnt/server/satisfactorycord/
  else
    APP_ROOT=$(find /tmp/satisfactorycord-unpack -maxdepth 2 -name package.json -print -quit | xargs dirname)
    cp -R "$APP_ROOT"/. /mnt/server/satisfactorycord/
  fi
  cd /mnt/server/satisfactorycord
  /mnt/server/satisfactorycord-node/bin/npm install --omit=dev
else
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/satisfactorycord
  echo "SATISFACTORYCORD_ARCHIVE_URL is empty. Upload SatisfactoryCord files into /home/container/satisfactorycord after install."
fi

echo "SatisfactoryCord egg installation complete."

variables.name: [Host] Reliable Messaging Port
variables.description: Satisfactory reliable messaging port. Clients connect to the primary game port, not this port.

variables.name: Automatic Updates
variables.description: Run SteamCMD update before SatisfactoryCord starts. Do not use this for major changes without backups.

variables.name: Validate Server Files
variables.description: When Automatic Updates is enabled, add SteamCMD validate. Leave empty for off, use 1 for on.

variables.name: SatisfactoryCord Archive URL
variables.description: Optional direct URL to satisfactorycord.zip. If blank, upload the SatisfactoryCord files to /home/container/satisfactorycord manually after install.

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: Bundled Node.js runtime version downloaded during installation.

variables.name: Satisfactory Executable
variables.description: Path inside the Pelican runtime container. The install script creates /home/container/FactoryServer.sh if needed.

variables.name: Satisfactory Working Directory
variables.description: Directory containing FactoryServer.sh.

variables.name: Satisfactory Arguments
variables.description: Arguments passed by SatisfactoryCord to FactoryServer. Keep as arguments, not a shell command.

variables.name: FactoryGame Log Path
variables.description: Optional FactoryGame.log path for event/chat parsing.

variables.name: Satisfactory API Host
variables.description: HTTPS API host from inside the same container.

variables.name: Satisfactory API Port
variables.description: HTTPS API port.

variables.name: Satisfactory API Token
variables.description: Optional Satisfactory Dedicated Server API token. Hidden from normal view.

variables.name: Reject Unauthorized API TLS
variables.description: Set false for the dedicated server's self-signed HTTPS certificate.

variables.name: Discord Enabled
variables.description: Start with false for first boot, then enable after FactoryServer works.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Discord bot token. Hidden from normal view.

variables.name: Discord Guild ID
variables.description: Guild/server ID where slash commands should be registered.

variables.name: Discord Chat Channel ID
variables.description: Channel ID for game chat relay.

variables.name: Discord Events Channel ID
variables.description: Channel ID for server events. Leave blank to reuse chat channel.

variables.name: Discord Admin Role ID
variables.description: Role allowed to run admin slash commands. Discord Administrator also works.

variables.name: Chat Moderation Enabled
variables.description: Block configured game chat before relaying it to Discord.

variables.name: Chat Blocked Words File
variables.description: Path to the child-friendly blocked words file. Edit this file in the Pelican file manager.

variables.name: Chat Blocked Terms
variables.description: Comma-separated terms blocked from Discord relay.

variables.name: Chat Blocked Patterns
variables.description: Comma-separated JavaScript regular expressions blocked from Discord relay.

variables.name: Chat Max Message Length
variables.description: Maximum game chat length allowed through to Discord.

variables.name: Chat Max Repeated Characters
variables.description: Block repeated-character spam at this count. Use 0 to disable.

variables.name: Block Discord Mentions
variables.description: Block game chat that tries to ping everyone, here, users, or roles in Discord.

variables.name: In-Game Admin Enabled
variables.description: Allow trusted in-game players to run SatisfactoryCord commands from chat.

variables.name: In-Game Admin Prefix
variables.description: Prefix for in-game SatisfactoryCord commands.

variables.name: In-Game Admin Players
variables.description: Comma-separated exact player names allowed to run in-game admin commands.

variables.name: Allow In-Game Console Command
variables.description: Allow !sc console from in-game chat. Keep false unless the server is trusted.

variables.name: Dashboard Host
variables.description: Dashboard bind host. Use 0.0.0.0 inside Pelican.

variables.name: Dashboard Port
variables.description: Optional dashboard port. Add a Pelican TCP allocation if exposing it.

variables.name: Wrapper Log Level
variables.description: SatisfactoryCord log level.

variables.name: Wrapper Auto Restart
variables.description: Restart FactoryServer after unexpected exit.

variables.name: Auto Restart Delay
variables.description: Seconds to wait before automatic restart.

variables.name: Max Crash Restarts
variables.description: Maximum crash restarts inside the crash window.

variables.name: Crash Restart Window
variables.description: Crash restart window in seconds.

variables.name: Number of Rotating Autosaves
variables.description: Number of session auto-saves to keep.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Maximum player count written to Game.ini.

variables.name: Client Initial Connection Timeout
variables.description: Time in seconds to wait for a new client connection.

variables.name: Client Established Connection Timeout
variables.description: Time in seconds before considering an established connection timed out.

variables.name: Satisfactory Branch Name
variables.description: Optional Steam branch. Accepted values are public, experimental, or blank.

variables.name: Satisfactory Branch Password
variables.description: Optional Steam beta branch password.

variables.name: Satisfactory Dedicated Server App ID
variables.description: Steam app ID for Satisfactory Dedicated Server.
